subject.target_stable_key: Target stable key, or entity_locator for an entity subject

facts.value: Complete claim for write, except inferred_name: only one preferred direct name (for example ftLk_SpecialN_RemoveArrow), following inferred_name_contract; no prose, wrapping quotes/backticks, signatures, or alternatives. Empty string for clear.
facts.rationale: Argument connecting the cited evidence to this value or clear operation. For inferred_name, put explanations, uncertainty, and alternative candidates here; value holds only the preferred name.

evidence.why: What this specific source record shows.

entities.note: Why this curated entity is needed for a supported fact.

merges.why: Evidence that both locators identify the same entity.
